### Meekness Is Not Weakness
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-may-23-2023.html
Passage: Titus 3:1-2
Points:
- Believers are commanded to live a lifestyle marked by meekness, peace, and humility instead of arrogance.
- True meekness is not weakness, but strength placed under control, following the example of Christ.
- Reacting to cultural hostility with angry rhetoric and name-calling damages Christian witness and wins no one.
- Human wrath cannot produce God's righteousness, so believers must remain slow to anger and quick to listen.

### Good Works that Profit
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/good-works-that-profit
Passage: Titus 3:8
Points:
- God's undeserved mercy toward us provides the moral motivation to do good even toward our enemies.
- Good works do not merit salvation or divine favor; rather, they are the necessary fruit of justifying faith.
- Sound biblical doctrine equips believers with the discernment needed to pursue works that are truly good.
- Christian leaders and church members must actively urge one another toward loving, practical service in the world.
